privS5Body: Due to the use of Roblox OAuth and Discord APIs, your data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including to countries without an EU adequacy decision. We apply appropriate safeguards, including:
privS5Item1: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, where applicable
privS5Item2: Transfer impact assessments and supplementary technical measures as needed
privS5Item3: Data minimization and strict access controls for transferred data
privS6Intro: We send notifications by email and as direct messages (DMs) from the HSR Discord bot:
privS6MandatoryBody: Security alerts (a sign-in from a new device), changes to the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy, and receipts for purchases and donations. These are needed to provide the service, so they cannot be switched off.
privS6OptionalPre: Newsletters and feature announcements – sent only with your consent. Opt out at any time via the unsubscribe link or by contacting
privS7C1Purpose: JWT session token. Essential for maintaining login state.
privS7TrackingNote: We do not use third-party tracking or analytics cookies. If Google AdSense ads are displayed, Google's own cookie policy applies.
privS8Body: The Service is not intended for children under 16 years of age in the EEA, unless the member state permits a lower digital age of consent (not below 13) and all legal requirements are met. If we learn that data has been collected from a child without the required consent, we will delete it without undue delay.
privS9Intro: We implement technical and organizational measures appropriate to risk, including:
privS9Item1: Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest for sensitive data
privS9Item2: Role-based access controls and least-privilege administrative access
privS9Item3: Secure handling, rotation, and storage of authentication tokens and secrets
privS9Item4: Full audit logging, anomaly monitoring, and incident response procedures
privS9Item5: Regular updates, patching, and security hardening of infrastructure
privS9Item6: Backups, recovery controls, and data integrity safeguards
privS9bIntro: If a personal data breach occurs, we follow this process:
privS9bItem1: Contain and assess the breach as soon as it is detected
privS9bItem2: Notify the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours where required by law
privS9bItem3: Notify affected users without undue delay if the breach is likely to result in a high risk to their rights
privS9bItem4: Document the breach, its effects, and the remedial action taken
privS9bNote: This process follows Articles 33-34 of the GDPR on the notification of personal data breaches.
privS10Intro: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose:
privS10Item1: Account and profile data: for the duration of the account and up to 30 days after a deletion request, unless longer retention is legally required.
privS10Item2: Authentication and security logs: up to 12 months to investigate abuse and incidents.
privS10Item3: Support and dispute records: up to 24 months after case closure.
privS10Item4: Game, duty, and schedule data: for the duration of the account.
privS10Item5: Exam and training logs: for the duration of the account, or as required by law.
privS10Item6: Consent records (optional emails): up to 3 years after withdrawal.
privS10Item7: Legal compliance records: as required by applicable law.
privS10Note: When retention is no longer necessary, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymized.

privS11Item2: Right to rectification – request correction of inaccurate data
privS11Item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
privS11Item6: Right to data portability – request your data in machine-readable format

trmS2Body: To use the parts of the Service that require signing in, you must explicitly accept these Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy when you first sign in. We record that you accepted, when, and the technical details of the acceptance (IP address, browser). If you do not agree, you may not use the parts of the Service that require signing in.

You are responsible for keeping your accounts' credentials confidential and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date where needed.
trmS4Body2: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law.
trmS5Body1: Access to protected Service features (e.g. duty system, exams, schedule, admin panels) requires linking your Discord account registered on the HSR Discord server.
trmS5Body2: The roles you hold on the HSR Discord server determine which features and permissions you have access to within the platform. Roles are managed exclusively on the Discord server by authorized staff.
trmS6Body1: The platform uses a priority-based permission system. Higher-priority roles grant broader access. Permissions are mapped to numerous defined flags covering duty, scheduling, supervision, admin functions, and more.
trmS6Body2: In-platform permissions update automatically based on Discord roles (every 60 seconds). Some permissions can be individually overridden by an administrator.

trmS8Intro: Users holding certain roles (e.g. Train Driver, Dispatcher, and related roles) are required to meet a weekly duty minimum.
trmS8Item1: Users who do not meet the weekly minimum (currently 2 hours of duty) automatically receive a warning.
trmS8Item2: If the minimum is missed again in another week while a warning is active, the membership ends automatically and the duty roles are removed. A warning is cleared after 2 weeks in a row in which the minimum is met.
trmS8Item3: You can appeal a warning or a termination through the link in the notification about it, before the deadline stated there.
trmS8Item4: Advance exemptions can be requested (e.g. for holiday or illness) via an administrator.
trmS8Item5: Exemptions (WeeklyDutyExemption) cover specific date ranges and require admin approval.
trmS9Intro: You enter a training programme (e.g. train driver, dispatcher) through an application form. Once accepted, the following rules apply:
trmS9Item1: The course material and the closing exam must be completed within the programme's deadline; access to the course material is limited in active time.
trmS9Item2: The course material is confidential: taking screenshots, photos or videos of it, or passing it on to anyone, is forbidden and leads to removal from the programme.
trmS9Item3: There is a limited number of attempts at the closing exam. Not starting an exam you are registered for shortens your training deadline.
trmS10Intro: Exams are conducted under rules set by the administrator. By participating in an exam, you accept the following:
trmS10Item1: Browser tab switching, window switching, and application focus loss are prohibited and automatically recorded.
trmS10Item2: An administrator may force-stop the exam at any time.
trmS10Item3: Multiple violations may result in exam invalidation (VIOLATION status) and sanctions.
trmS10Item4: Exam results (score, status, answers) are permanently stored and may be used for eligibility decisions.
trmS10Item5: Exam images and uploaded content are stored on Cloudflare R2.
trmS12Body1: The support ticket system must be used for genuine issues and questions. Abusive, deliberately misleading, or spam submissions may result in account suspension.
trmS12Body2: You agree to receive the notifications needed to provide the Service by email and as Discord messages; section 22 has the details. Optional communications (e.g. newsletters) are only sent with your consent.
trmS13Intro: The iOS and Android mobile application communicates with the web platform via OAuth 2.0.
trmS13Item1: Mobile access tokens are valid for 7 days; refresh tokens for 90 days.
trmS13Item2: Tokens are stored in the device's secure storage (SecureStore).
trmS13Item3: On a 401 error, the mobile app automatically attempts to refresh the token.
trmS13Item4: The iOS Live Activity feature displays active duty data in real time on the notification surface.

trmS21Body1: The forum (hsrgames.hu/forum) is a public surface: posts, replies, attached images and videos, and your public profile can be read without signing in and may be indexed by search engines. Posting, replying, liking and following require a linked Discord and Roblox account.
trmS21Body2: Content you upload stays yours. By publishing it you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, display and transmit it for the purpose of running the forum. That licence ends when the content is deleted. Before posting, make sure you have the right to publish what you are posting.
trmS21Item1: Do not publish unlawful, hateful, harassing, misleading or adult content.
trmS21Item2: Do not impersonate anyone, or post content that appears to be an official HSR announcement.
trmS21Item3: Do not publish anyone's personal data without their consent.
trmS21Item4: Do not use the storage as general file hosting unrelated to the forum, or work around the upload limits.
trmS21Item5: Embedded third-party content (Medal, YouTube links and the like) is the responsibility of that provider; you are the one sharing the link.
trmS21Body3: Upload and character limits depend on your account tier and are shown in the forum. Supporter benefits (higher limits, editing posts, your own locomotive photo) may end when supporter status ends; content already published is not deleted because of this.
trmS21Body4: Moderators may remove a post, on report or on their own initiative, and may restrict forum access. A deleted post's text and files are removed for good; its place in the conversation may remain, marked as deleted, so the thread holds together.
privS15Intro: Using the forum creates the following data. Some of it is public — visible to anyone, with no account:
privS15Item1: Public: the text of your posts and replies, attached images and videos, the time they were published, the like, repost and view counts, and the topic tags on them.
privS15Item2: Public: your profile name, @handle, picture and the badges tied to your Discord roles. You can restrict your profile's visibility in settings, but your posts stay in the public feed.
privS15Item3: Public: who you follow, who follows you, and the follower counts.
privS15Item4: Not public: the list of posts you have liked (only you see it), the reports you file and their reasons (only moderators see them), and your notifications.
privS15Item5: Not public: the interest scores we compute for feed ordering from the topics you interact with. They decay daily and are never shared with another member.
privS15Item6: Uploaded files are stored in Cloudflare R2 and served from a public address. If you share an external link (Medal, YouTube and the like), loading the player connects your browser directly to that provider, which is outside our processing.
privS15Retention: Retention: posts and their files are kept until deleted. A deleted post's text and files are removed for good. Read notifications are deleted after 7 days, unread ones after 30. Abandoned uploads that were never published are removed from storage within 24 hours.
privS15Note: Public content can be saved or quoted by others before you delete it. Deleting removes it from our systems; we have no control over copies made elsewhere.

aboutMetaDescription: What the Hungarian State Railways is, how the organisation works, and what we are trying to build.
aboutHeroLine: Running a railway is teamwork. Everyone here is a volunteer.
aboutHeroBody: The Hungarian State Railways is a Hungarian railway simulation on Roblox, and the organisation behind it. We run to a timetable, we train and examine our staff, and we build our own tools for all of it — the timetable, duty tracking, exams, the forum.
aboutStoryBody: It started as a game where the trains ran whenever. Anyone who took it seriously soon missed the rest of it: the duty roster, the signals, the responsibility for a train leaving on time. Those arrived one at a time — first as agreements between people, then as rules, and finally as systems that keep track of them.
aboutWhyHeading: Why we do it this way
aboutWhyBody: Because what makes railways satisfying is what follows from their rules. A signal is not red for its own sake, it is red so that two trains never meet; an exam is not hard for its own sake, it is there so you can rely on the person working beside you. Everything built here serves those two things: making duty predictable, and making it visible who took on what.
aboutGoalsLead: We measure ourselves on four things, in this order.
aboutGoal1Body: We run by the rules of the real Hungarian railway: signals, timetable, operating instructions. Driving here teaches you why a train is standing still, too.
aboutGoal2Body: Every position starts with training and an exam, with a supervisor and practice runs. A rank is earned, never handed out.
aboutGoal3Title: An organisation you can see into
aboutGoal3Body: The ranks, the permissions attached to them and the roster itself are public. If you want to know who a decision belongs to, you can look it up.
aboutGoal4Body: Timetable, duty tracking, exams, forum, Discord bot: we write all of it ourselves, because off-the-shelf tools cannot run a railway.
aboutOrgBody: The organisation is made of ranks, the ranks are Discord roles, and every permission hangs off them — so a promotion happens in one place and applies everywhere. The full roster, rank by rank, is on the team page.
aboutJoinBody: Anyone can ride: the game is open, and the timetable and forum are readable without an account. Staff applications go through Discord whenever recruitment is open — from there it is training, supervision and an exam before your first solo duty.

For the Discord messages, allow direct messages from server members. You choose what arrives on which channel under Settings → Notifications.
emailExamDayRulesTitle: What to know on exam day
emailTrainingPassNoSupervisionNext: This programme has no supervision stage: the instructors grant the full role themselves. They will be in touch soon — until then there is nothing you need to do.
emailClosingExamFailNext: Go over the course material again, especially the parts you found hardest. Tomorrow at 6:00 we will ask again whether you want to sit the exam — you can try again then.
emailTrainingReapplyNote: In {days} days you can apply for the same programme again on the website by filling in the application form. You will start with a clean slate.
emailTrainingRemovalMistake: If you think this is a mistake, open a ticket — the leadership can review the removal.
emailSupervisionPromotionLeaveNote: If you know in advance that you'll be away for a while (a holiday, for example), tell the leadership: during approved leave the weekly minimum is reduced proportionally.
emailSupervisionClaimedBody: {name} has taken on your supervision request.
emailSupervisionClaimedNext: Message them on Discord and agree on when and where the supervision happens. If they don't start it in time, your request automatically goes back to the other instructors.
emailSupervisionReleasedSubject: Your supervision request is waiting for a new instructor
emailSupervisionReleasedExpired: The instructor who took on your supervision did not start it in time, so your request has gone back to the other instructors.
emailSupervisionReleasedReleased: The instructor who took on your supervision has handed the request back, so it has gone back to the other instructors.
emailSupervisionReleasedNext: There is nothing you need to do: your request stays open, and we will tell you as soon as another instructor takes it on.
emailTermsUpdatedAccept: The next time you sign in to the website we will ask you to accept the new version. Until you do, the parts of the website that need you to be signed in are not available.
dmFooter: HSR notification · You can switch it off with the button below

dmPassSupervisionNext: Next step: {count} successful supervisions next to an instructor. Request the first one with the button below!

settingsNotifyDiscordNotLinked: No Discord account is linked, so we cannot send Discord messages.
settingsNotifyNoEmail: There is no email address on your account, so we cannot send emails. We take the address from your Discord account.

trmS9Item4: After passing the closing exam, the number of consecutive successful supervisions the programme requires must be completed within its deadline.
trmS9Item5: If the deadline passes, the attempts run out or the rules are broken, the trainee role is removed and you leave the programme. You can apply for the same programme again 7 days after the removal.
trmS9Item6: The current deadlines and numbers are on the training pages of the website and in the guide sent when you are accepted; they can differ between programmes.
trmS23Body1: We send notifications about training, exams, duty, tickets and documents by email and as direct messages (DMs) from the HSR Discord bot.
trmS23Item1: You can set at any time, under Settings → Notifications, which topics reach you on which channel; both channels can be switched off per topic.
trmS23Item2: Some emails are always sent regardless of your settings: a sign-in from a new device, changes to these Terms and the Privacy Policy, and receipts for purchases and donations.
trmS23Item3: For Discord messages to be delivered, you must allow direct messages from members of the HSR server. If Discord does not deliver a message, we show it on your settings page.
trmS23Item4: Notifications are a convenience: deadlines, exam times and obligations apply even if you switched a notification off or it did not arrive. You can always find them on the website.
trmS23Body2: Section 6 of the Privacy Policy describes the data processed for notifications.
privS2_2Item5: The email address of your Discord account — this is where we send email notifications
privS2_7Item4: Your notification settings: per topic, whether you want emails and Discord messages
privS2_7Item5: We use your Discord ID as the recipient of Discord messages (DMs); we do not store the messages' content, only the time Discord last refused to deliver one
privS2_7Item6: A log of the emails sent: recipient, subject, content and delivery status
privS2_10Item1: Which version of the Terms of Service / Privacy Policy you accepted, and when
privS2_10Item2: The IP address and browser (user agent) used when accepting — to prove the acceptance
privS3Row11Data: Accepted version, time, IP address, browser
privS6ServiceBody: Notifications about training, exams, duty and the schedule, tickets, documents and instructor work, and letters from the leadership. You can switch them off per topic, separately for email and Discord, under Settings → Notifications; what you switch off is not sent on that channel.
privS6DiscordBody: Discord messages are sent by the HSR bot to your Discord ID; Discord (Discord Inc., USA) processes the message content under its own privacy policy to deliver it. We do not store the content of the messages we send. If Discord refuses delivery (for example because you switched off direct messages), we record the time so we can show it on your settings page; it is cleared with the next message that arrives.
privS10Item8: Notification settings: while the account exists. The time of a refused Discord delivery: until the next message arrives. The log of sent emails: kept as the record of delivery; you can ask for it to be deleted.
privS10Item9: Records of accepting the terms (version, time, IP address, browser): while the account exists; deleted together with the account.
